signals.name: Micron Technology, Inc.
signals.label: Congress, Wall Street 13Fs, and Retail Converge Ahead of Earnings
signals.detail: At least six Congress members disclosed Micron buys in 2026, including Rep. Dan Newhouse (up to $15,000, 2026-07-10) and Rep. Michael Rulli (up to $15,000, 2026-06-25), alongside earlier-year buys from Sen. John Fetterman, Rep. Gilbert Cisneros, Rep. Tony Wied and Rep. Cleo Fields. Q2 2026 13F filings showed Morgan Stanley and UBS both boosting Micron stakes and overall hedge-fund ownership rising ~7.5%, while Soros Fund Management's position grew roughly 7.9x to ~$25.9M. The binary catalyst has now resolved: Micron reported fiscal Q4/full-year 2026 results on 2026-09-30 with revenue of $54.23B (vs. ~$51.07B consensus) and adjusted EPS of $33.42 (vs. ~$31.16-31.61 est.), DRAM revenue +343% y/y to $39.8B, and fiscal Q1 guidance of ~$61.5B revenue / $38.15 EPS, both well above Street estimates (~$57B / $35.40); Rosenblatt, DA Davidson and Mizuho all hiked price targets afterward. MU remains the #2 most-mentioned ticker on r/wallstreetbets (311-321 mentions/24h as of 2026-10-02/03, per AltIndex), behind only Nike.
signals.takeaway: A rare full-stack alignment -- multiple congressional buyers across both parties, expanding institutional 13F ownership, and top-of-list retail bullishness -- all converged on Micron ahead of its earnings print, and the print itself beat on every major line, with analysts raising targets afterward and retail attention still near the top of the board, even as Michael Burry's options-based short sits on the other side of the trade.

signals.name: Uber Technologies, Inc.
signals.label: Congress and Ackman's Largest Position Meet a Reddit Mention Spike
signals.detail: Paul Pelosi bought 200 Uber call options (strike $50, exp. March 2027) on 2026-05-29, disclosed alongside an identical-structure Intel options buy. Bill Ackman's Pershing Square grew its Uber stake 15% in Q2 2026 to 34.33M shares worth $2.48B -- Uber remains Pershing Square's single largest disclosed position at roughly 13% of the portfolio, per its 2026-08-14 13F filing. Reddit mentions of Uber spiked sharply heading into 2026-09-30, per AltIndex, making it one of the platform's most-discussed tickers that day, but that spike has since faded -- UBER no longer appears in AltIndex's top-20 WSB mention list as of 2026-10-02/03. The congressional side has also turned slightly less bullish: Rep. Ro Khanna disclosed a small UBER sell on 2026-08-03 (filed 2026-09-01).
signals.takeaway: A congressional options buy, the largest position in one of the most prominent activist hedge funds' portfolio, and an extreme retail mention spike all landed on the same ticker -- an unusually clean three-way convergence at the time, though it has since cooled: the Reddit spike proved transient and a small Khanna sell is a mild counter-signal, so this one reads as fading rather than strengthening.

signals.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
signals.label: Tepper and Ackman Both Add as Congress Buys and Reddit Chatter Tops Charts
signals.detail: Rep. Michael Rulli's STOCK Act violation disclosure (filed 2026-08-07) covered 32 trades, 22 of them past the 45-day deadline -- 3 of those late trades were in Meta, alongside Palantir, Pfizer, Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia and Oracle. In Q2 2026 13F filings, David Tepper's Appaloosa Management increased its Meta stake roughly 55% (to ~$380M, a 5% portfolio position) and Bill Ackman's Pershing Square added 20% (to roughly 10% of its portfolio) -- two closely tracked 'super-investors' both adding in the same quarter. Meta ranked among the top two most-mentioned tickers on r/wallstreetbets (~170 mentions) in the 24 hours into 2026-09-30, per AltIndex, behind only Micron, though mentions have since cooled to ~65/24h as of 2026-10-02/03. A fresh caution flag: CEO Mark Zuckerberg sold shares on 2026-09-24 (~$775-779/share per Form 4) and Chief Product Officer Chris Cox sold 40,000 shares on 2026-09-21 (~$700-725/share) -- insider selling into the September highs, separate from the congress/13F/retail signal.
signals.takeaway: Two marquee hedge-fund managers adding to Meta in the same 13F quarter, a Congress member's late-disclosed buying, and top-tier (if now cooling) Reddit attention all point the same direction -- one of the cleaner bullish convergences of this sweep, tempered by both Rep. Dan Crenshaw's unrelated in-and-out Meta options round-trip earlier in the year and fresh insider selling by Zuckerberg and Cox into September's highs.

signals.name: NVIDIA Corporation
signals.label: Congress and a Live Quant Buy Signal Meet Cooling but Still Top-5 Reddit Attention
signals.detail: Rep. John McGuire disclosed an NVDA buy on 2026-08-18 in the same Merrill Lynch SEP IRA where he sold Apple, part of a pattern that has made Nvidia one of Congress's most-traded names. In Q2 2026 13F filings, Renaissance Technologies added ~4.56M shares (1.8x its prior stake) with its quant models issuing a live 'strong buy' signal on NVDA, while Soros Fund Management and ARK Invest added roughly 391,000 and 346,000 shares respectively -- even as D1 Capital, Discovery Capital and Third Point fully exited. NVDA's r/wallstreetbets rank has slipped further to roughly #3 (173-186 mentions/24h as of 2026-10-02/03, per AltIndex), behind Nike and Micron, continuing the cooling trend from prior weeks; StockTwits still shows NVDA near the top of its own mention count (~20,000). Cutting the other way in Congress itself: Sen. Sheldon Whitehouse disclosed his fourth distinct NVDA sale of 2026 (this one executed 2026-08-13, filed 2026-09-02), having also sold in January, May and June. No Q3 2026 13F data exists yet for any holder (those filings aren't due until mid-November); a secondary-source claim of an '84.52% Renaissance Technologies reduction' circulating online could not be corroborated against any real filing and is treated as a data-source artifact, not fact.
signals.takeaway: Congress, at least one major systematic hedge fund with a live buy signal, and persistent (if cooling) retail attention are all still pointed at NVDA even as other institutional holders head for the exits and at least one senator keeps repeatedly trimming -- a genuine split-screen among both 13F filers and Congress members rather than a clean consensus, but enough three-way overlap to flag.

signals.name: Alphabet Inc.
signals.label: Berkshire's $17B Add Meets a Congressional Buy and Top-5 Reddit Buzz
signals.detail: Rep. Josh Gottheimer, a former Microsoft executive who also disclosed a large MSFT buy in August, separately disclosed a purchase of Alphabet preferred convertible depositary shares (GOOGM/GOOGN), $8,008-$120,000, on 2026-07-24 (filed ~2026-08-10). Berkshire Hathaway's Q2 2026 13F -- its first full quarter under Greg Abel's stock-picking lead -- showed roughly $17B added to Alphabet (about 60% via a rare direct private placement from Alphabet itself, at a 6.5% discount, worth ~$10B of that total). Fresh reporting since confirms the scale: Berkshire's Alphabet stake grew from $5.59B (2026-12-31 cost basis reference) to $36.37B as of 2026-09-25 -- roughly sixfold in 2026 -- making Alphabet Berkshire's 3rd-largest holding (upgraded from 4th-largest as previously tracked), behind only Apple and American Express. On r/wallstreetbets, Google/Alphabet ranked among the top five most-mentioned tickers (~132-148 mentions) in the 24 hours into 2026-09-30 and into 2026-10-02/03, per AltIndex.
signals.takeaway: A former Microsoft insider in Congress adding Alphabet, Berkshire's largest tech conviction bet under new stock-picker Greg Abel (now confirmed as the firm's #3 holding after a near-sixfold 2026 build), and sustained top-5 Reddit attention are all aligned on the name -- though Rep. Pete Sessions disclosed a GOOGL sale on 2026-09-14 (filed 2026-09-18) as part of a broader September liquidation spree, and Rep. Thomas Kean Jr.'s blind trust separately sold GOOGL around 2026-08-27 while rotating into AI-infrastructure 'picks-and-shovels' names (Linde, MasTec) -- a reminder that not every member agrees.

signals.name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
signals.label: Congress, a 28-Fund 13F Consensus, and WSB Converge as AMD Crosses $1 Trillion
signals.detail: Rep. Josh Gottheimer bought AMD stock three separate times in a five-week stretch (2026-04-23, 2026-04-27, 2026-05-05), each in the $1,001-$15,000 band through his Morgan Stanley Select UMA account, with Rep. Gilbert Cisneros also trading the name repeatedly -- congressional trackers show 14 disclosed AMD trades in the trailing six months, 11 of them buys. On the institutional side, AMD was a Q2 2026 13F consensus buy across 28 tracked hedge funds (net +$8.3B in aggregate position value), led by Citadel Advisors (~$929M, 1,599,430 shares), Millennium Management (~$502M), Renaissance Technologies (~$464M) and Tiger Global Management (~$392M, a new position also tracked separately in this file's super-investor section). The catalyst tying it together: AMD closed above a $1 trillion market cap for the first time on 2026-09-21 at $612.46 (+9% that day), triggered by the $600 share-price threshold embedded in its October 2025 OpenAI chip-supply deal (a 6-gigawatt agreement granting OpenAI a warrant on up to 160M AMD shares at $0.01 each); AMD is up roughly 185% year-to-date in 2026. WSB logged 61 mentions in the 24 hours into 2026-10-02/03 with 90.6% bullish sentiment, per AltIndex.
signals.takeaway: The congressional buying actually predates the $1T breakout by four to five months, so this reads less like smart money front-running a specific catalyst and more like a trend congress, hedge funds and retail each independently piled onto at different stages -- congress early in spring, 28 hedge funds through the Q2 13F cycle, and WSB now celebrating the trillion-dollar milestone; worth watching whether any member discloses a fresh trade in the weeks just after the September 21 OpenAI-warrant trigger.
